title: What to Wear on Zanzibar
excerpt: Zanzibar is mostly Muslim. Here is what to wear in Stone Town, in villages and on the beach, so you feel comfortable and respectful.
body:
Most people on Zanzibar are Muslim, and dress is generally modest. As a visitor, adapting your clothing is a sign of respect.

## Stone Town and villages

- Cover shoulders and knees, for both women and men.
- Loose, light clothing works best in the heat: linen trousers, long skirts, t-shirts.
- A scarf is handy for covering shoulders.

## On the beach

At hotel beaches and resorts, swimwear is normal. Do not walk into villages or shops in swimwear.

## Topless

Topless sunbathing is not accepted.

## Mosques

Non-Muslims generally cannot enter mosques.

## Ramadan

During Ramadan, avoid eating, drinking and smoking in public in Stone Town and villages during daylight. Restaurants for tourists usually remain open.

## Men

Men should also avoid walking around shirtless outside the beach.

Read [Zanzibar travel guide](/blog/zanzibar-travel-guide/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
